title: lmmresample: Valid inference for mixed models of trial-structured physiological data. A tutorial (code and results)
description: Code and results that reproduce the simulation study, the analysis of the pupillometry data set and the figures of the article presenting the R package lmmresample, which provides permutation and bootstrap inference for linear mixed models of trial-structured, densely sampled physiological data.
